mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 64-degree temperatures under clear skies at Verona Community Park. The moon is currently in a waxing gibbous phase, and you can catch the International Space Station flying overhead starting at 5:01 PM tonight; it will rise in the west-northwest over Cross Plains and head toward the northeast near the Home Depot, staying low near the horizon.

City of Verona offices will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, so please note that refuse and recycling pickup is delayed to Friday, November 27. Additionally, the city is moving forward with expansion plans for the Public Works and Utilities facility to better accommodate our growing population.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, followed by live music tomorrow at Paddy Mac's, and don't forget trivia nights coming up next week at the Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.

Looking at the most recent police report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct following a domestic disturbance.
Today's featured flavor is the delicious Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently open until 10:30 PM, so feel free to stop by and grab a scoop before they close for the evening.
